title: A customer question about Uploading Through the Web App

question.author: member_097
question.body: I need a short answer about uploading through the web app. What should I expect according to the official documentation?

answers.author: cloudbox_support
answers.body: The current Sharing Files and Folders documentation says: For larger files, use the desktop or mobile client, which support uploads up to 20 GB. A web upload that exceeds 2 GB fails partway through with no data saved; you can retry it from the desktop client without corrupting anything. The API also supports uploads up to 20 GB. Uploads made through a browser are capped at 2 GB per file. That official page is the source to follow if a community reply describes an older version. Check the complete section there for surrounding conditions before applying it to your case.
